description: Clock running a measure of beats, with a separate output for each note division of that measure

params.text: Sets the tempo in whole beats per minute, 1 to 350
Adds hundredths of a beat per minute to the tempo, 0 to 0.99
Sets how many beats make up a measure, 1 to 32
Sets the note the beat is counted in, a half, quarter, eighth or sixteenth note
Starts and stops the clock; every output rests at 0V while it is stopped, and each press sends a pulse from the run output
Restarts the measure from its first beat and sends a pulse from the reset output

inputs.text: 0V to 10V adds 0 to 350 beats per minute to the tempo set by the BPM knob
0V to 10V adds 0 to 0.99 beats per minute to the tempo
0V to 10V adds 0 to 32 beats to the length of the measure
0V to 10V shortens the note the beat is counted in, by one halving for every 3.3V, and it stops at a sixteenth note

outputs.text: A 10V pulse at the start of each measure
A 10V pulse on each beat of the measure
A 10V pulse three times per quarter note, for triplets
A 10V pulse on every quarter note
A 10V pulse on every eighth note
A 10V pulse on every sixteenth note
A 10V pulse on every thirty-second note
A 10V pulse on every sixty-fourth note
A 10V pulse on every hundred-and-twenty-eighth note
A 1ms 10V pulse whenever the clock is reset, which happens on the RESET button and again each time the clock is started
A 1ms 10V pulse each time the clock is started or stopped

notes: the display reads the tempo, the beats per measure over the note value, and a count of the beats left in the current measure
the clock comes up stopped, and it is stopped again every time the patch is loaded; every output rests at 0V until RUN is pressed
